name: Lurbinectedin Monotherapy (Relapsed SCLC)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS Reference Regimen: Phase II Basket Trial (Trigo et al. Lancet Oncol 2020)

supportiveCare: G-CSF primary prophylaxis recommended if febrile neutropenia risk is elevated or in patients with extensive prior marrow injury.
monitoring: CBC with differential weekly during cycle 1, then prior to each cycle
Liver function tests (ALT, AST, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin) and serum creatinine before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Delay cycle until ANC >= 1,500/mcL and platelets >= 100,000/mcL. If delayed > 2 weeks or Grade 4 neutropenia/thrombocytopenia occurs, reduce dose to 2.6 mg/m2.
Withhold until recovery to Grade <= 1. Reduce dose to 2.6 mg/m2 upon resumption.

drugs.name: Lurbinectedin
drugs.notes: Lurbinectedin 3.2 mg/m2 IV infused over 60 minutes on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Preferred second-line chemotherapy for platinum-resistant/sensitive SCLC.
